## Interaction style

- Default to concise responses. Elaborate only when complexity genuinely warrants it.
- If uncertain, say so explicitly rather than proceeding with low-confidence guesses.
- Do not summarize what you just did unless asked or a selected workflow requires an operational report.

## Hard constraints

- Never add secrets, tokens, or credentials to any file that will be committed.
- Never silence linter warnings with suppression comments without a written justification in the same commit message.
- Preserve existing user work. Do not stage, commit, switch branches, or discard changes unless explicitly asked and permitted by the selected agent.
- Read applicable repository instructions before acting. If the requested workflow conflicts with them, stop and explain the conflict rather than silently weakening either requirement.
